threads.title: Q3 FY26 wage hike margin impact
threads.evidence: Anticipated wage hike impact of at most 180 bps was absorbed as Q3FY26 EBITDA margin reached 19.4%.

history.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
history.quote: We anticipate an impact of 180 basis points on next quarter's margins due to wage hikes.

threads.title: Q3 FY26 wage hike margin offset

history.speaker: Vinit Teredesai

threads.title: FY26 margin improvement
threads.evidence: FY26 EBITDA margin improved to 19.0% from 17.2% in FY25, meeting the 100 bps target.

history.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
history.quote: we are looking at 100 basis point improvement in FY26, and probably another 100 basis point in FY27. That's what we have mentioned.

threads.title: FY27 revenue aspiration
threads.evidence: Management consistently reiterated the $2 billion revenue aspiration for FY27 across multiple calls.

history.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
history.quote: We are making steady progress towards our aspiration of reaching $2 billion by end of FY27.

history.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
history.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.

history.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
history.quote: In terms of your last question, and then I'll come back to the enterprises side, the $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.

threads.title: Net Debt over EBITDA leverage

history.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
history.quote: The leverage, that is the Net Debt over the combined EBITDA, is going to be 1.9 times-2.5 times based on how much will be the open offer acceptance.

history.quote: So, at 50% plus 1 share to 100%, it is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030.

business.text: Persistent Systems Limited is a global company specializing in software products, services, and technology innovation, offering complete product life cycle services, digital engineering, and enterprise modernization. The company sells to enterprises across industries such as BFSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences, and Software, Hi-Tech and Emerging Industries, making money by providing software services and engineering solutions.

bull.point: The company maintains a strong return profile with an ROE of 27.2% and an ROCE of 34.4% in FY26.
Debt-to-equity improved significantly, falling from 0.17 in FY23 to 0.07 by September 2026.

bear.point: Debtor days lengthened from 61 in FY22 to 83 in FY26, indicating slower cash conversion from customers.
Q2 FY27 PAT declined by 25.3% year-on-year, while EBITDA margin dropped to 13.6%.
